newsitem.title: UK: Sears sells stake in mall for 79.9 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Sears sells stake in mall for 79.9 mln stg.

text.p: British retailer Sears Plc said on Thursday it has sold its 50 percent stake in a shopping centre in Glasgow, Scotland for 79.9 million stg in cash to DespaFonds, an open ended property fund based in Frankfurt, Germany.
Sears said the the net book value of the disposed is 58.7 million stg, resulting in a net profit to the company after related costs of 19 million.
The shopping centre was jointly owned by Sears and the Church Commissioners for England who have also sold their 50 percent stake, said Sears.

Liam Strong, chief executive of Sears, said, "In the light of the group's cash resources the board will be reviewing options available for returning any surplus cash to shareholders in an appropriate manner".
